caption: Figure 7. Differences in MRR over all eligible cases and pointwise 95% confidence intervals across model-training structures and relation-feature configurations in the three evaluations. The three rows for each contrast represent forward-chaining, validation, and test evaluations. Filled and open circles indicate that the joint improvement criteria were met and not met, respectively.
